## Contributor checklist

- [ ] Every commit is cryptographically signed and has a matching DCO sign-off (`git commit -S -s`).
- [ ] I ran the applicable checks in CONTRIBUTING.md and recorded their results above.
- [ ] I added or updated regression coverage and documentation where applicable, or explained why they are unnecessary.
- [ ] For visual changes, I included the required before and after evidence, or this PR is nonvisual.
